history.created_by: LABEL name=RustFS vendor=RustFS Team maintainer=RustFS Team <dev@rustfs.com> version=v1.0.3 release=1.0.3 build-date= vcs-ref= summary=High-performance distributed object storage system compatible with S3 API description=RustFS is a distributed object storage system written in Rust, supporting erasure coding, multi-tenant management, and observability. url=https://rustfs.com license=Apache-2.0

RUN |3 RELEASE=1.0.3 BUILD_DATE= VCS_REF= /bin/sh -c apk upgrade --no-cache &&     apk add --no-cache     ca-certificates     coreutils     curl     tzdata     && test "$(TZ=Asia/Kolkata date +%z)" = "+0530" # buildkit
RUN |3 RELEASE=1.0.3 BUILD_DATE= VCS_REF= /bin/sh -c chmod +x /usr/bin/rustfs /entrypoint.sh # buildkit

RUN |3 RELEASE=1.0.3 BUILD_DATE= VCS_REF= /bin/sh -c addgroup -g 10001 -S rustfs &&     adduser -u 10001 -G rustfs -S rustfs -D &&     mkdir -p /data/.rustfs/events /data/.rustfs/audit /logs /opt/rustfs &&     ln -s /data/.rustfs/events /opt/rustfs/events &&     ln -s /data/.rustfs/audit /opt/rustfs/audit &&     chown -R rustfs:rustfs /data /logs &&     chmod 0750 /data /logs # buildkit
ENV RUSTFS_CONSOLE_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=* RUSTFS_VOLUMES=/data RUSTFS_OBS_LOGGER_LEVEL=warn RUSTFS_OBS_LOG_DIRECTORY=/logs RUSTFS_OBS_ENVIRONMENT=production

Labels.description: RustFS is a distributed object storage system written in Rust, supporting erasure coding, multi-tenant management, and observability.
Labels.name: RustFS
Labels.summary: High-performance distributed object storage system compatible with S3 API
